audit.why: Both layers already correctly state that Dredge Line is a hook/pull, not a dash, so Poppy's W (which only cancels dashes) cannot stop it — that's the single most important interaction here and it's stated plainly.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.spikes[3].text (Late) says W Steadfast Presence grants 'slow-resist and knock-up' — neither is in Poppy's kit. W is armor/MR passive plus an active that grounds and slows dashers; the knockup/untargetable/zone effects belong to R, not W.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json W flags are dash/slow/zone only, no knockup or tenacity-adjacent effect. Attributing a knockup to W would tell a reader to expect displacement from an ability that doesn't have it.
audit.corrected: Restate W's actual effect: grounds and slows the dash, no knockup or slow-resist claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Dredge Line as matchup-defining with no cooldown number.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s by rank — the number a reader needs to know how long lane is 'free' after a whiffed hook.

edits.before: In 5v5 you finally edge ahead: your R zones his Depth Charge setup and E pins peel his dives, while W Steadfast Presence's slow-resist and knock-up stop enemy follow-up dashes.
edits.after: In 5v5 you finally edge ahead: your R zones his Depth Charge setup and E pins peel his dives, while W Steadfast Presence grounds and slows any follow-up dash trying to reach your backline.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. It writes your spacing rules. - W Steadfast Presence is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown; his only real engage, so dodge it and the lane is free until it's back. - W Steadfast Presence is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

notes: Packet's suspectNames flag on 'Steadfast Presence's' is a false positive (it's Poppy's own real W name, possessive form) — no fix needed there, but the surrounding sentence had a real fabricated-effect bug (slow-resist/knockup) which I did fix.
